CssExtractRspackPlugin.summary.en:
CssExtractRspackPlugin is the CSS extract plugin for Lynx.
It works just like the [CssExtractRspackPlugin](https://rspack.rs/plugins/rspack/css-extract-rspack-plugin.html) in Web.
CssExtractRspackPlugin.summary.text: CssExtractRspackPlugin 是 Lynx 的 CSS 提取插件。其用法与 Web 中的 [CssExtractRspackPlugin](https://rspack.rs/plugins/rspack/css-extract-rspack-plugin.html) 相同。

CssExtractRspackPlugin.defaultOptions.su.en: `defaultOptions` is the default options that the [`CssExtractRspackPlugin`](api:CssExtractRspackPlugin) uses.
CssExtractRspackPlugin.defaultOptions.su.text: `defaultOptions` 是 [`CssExtractRspackPlugin`](api:CssExtractRspackPlugin) 使用的默认选项。

CssExtractRspackPlugin.loader.summary.text: 用于提取 CSS 的 loader。

CssExtractRspackPlugin.loader.remarks.en: It should be used with the ['css-loader'](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/css-loader).

CssExtractRspackPlugin.apply.summary.en: The entry point of a webpack plugin.

CssExtractRspackPluginOptions.chunkFilen.en: The name of non-initial CSS chunk files
CssExtractRspackPluginOptions.chunkFilen.text: 非初始 CSS chunk 文件的名称

CssExtractRspackPluginOptions.chunkFilen.en:
When set, CSS chunks of lazy bundles still go to
`.lynx/lazy-bundle/<name>/<layer>.css` (or `.lynx/lazy-bundle/<name>.css`
when the chunk has no layer); this template applies to the other chunks.
CssExtractRspackPluginOptions.chunkFilen.text:
设置后，lazy bundle 的 CSS chunk 仍会输出到
`.lynx/lazy-bundle/<name>/<layer>.css`（chunk 没有 layer 时为 `.lynx/lazy-bundle/<name>.css`）；该模板仅作用于其他 chunk。

CssExtractRspackPluginOptions.filename.s.en: The name of each output bundle.

LoaderOptions.summary.en: The options of CSS extract loader.
LoaderOptions.summary.text: CSS 提取 loader 的选项。

LoaderOptions.emit.summary.en:
The same as [mini-css-extract-plugin](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/mini-css-extract-plugin/tree/master?tab=readme-ov-file#emit).
Control whether emit the CSS to filesystem.

- If `true`(default), emits a file (writes a file to the filesystem).

- If `false`, the plugin will extract the CSS but will not emit the file.

It is often useful to disable this option for server-side packages.
LoaderOptions.emit.summary.text:
与 [mini-css-extract-plugin](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/mini-css-extract-plugin/tree/master?tab=readme-ov-file#emit) 相同。控制是否将 CSS 输出到文件系统。

- 若为 `true`（默认），则输出文件（将文件写入文件系统）。

- 若为 `false`，插件会提取 CSS，但不会输出文件。

对于服务端包，通常可以禁用该选项。

LoaderOptions.layer.summary.en: The layer of the CSS execution.
